title: MarqRadar: see your brand's online threats in 90 seconds
summary: Enter your brand's official URL and see phishing, counterfeit, gray-market and malicious ad threats in 90 seconds. A free brand self-check with no sign-up.
body_markdown:
Most brands aren’t the first to spot threats to them online.


They find out after a customer complaint comes in, sales drop in a market they didn’t expect, or the legal team shares an impersonator site. By then the threat has often been running for weeks, sometimes months. Not because brands ignore threats.


Until now, just finding out how exposed your brand is has been hard. You had to meet with a vendor, scope the threats and spend weeks setting up a system before you saw a first result.


So most brands only see their threats after something has gone wrong. MarqVision has cut that process to 90 seconds.[MarqRadar](https://www.marqvision.com/marqradar?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=MarqRadar_launch&utm_content=kr_blog) , our new free scan, starts a brand self-check as soon as you enter your official brand URL. No sign-up, nothing to install.


## **What one self-check shows you**


[MarqRadar](https://www.marqvision.com/marqradar?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=MarqRadar_launch&utm_content=kr_blog) scans the main online channels where your brand actually appears and shows its threats at a glance.


- Phishing sites impersonating your brand
- Typosquatted and cloned domains that mimic your official URL
- Counterfeits sold on e-commerce platforms
- Gray-market distribution by unauthorized sellers
- Fake events and promotions that impersonate your brand
- Paid search ads that hijack your brand keywords


The results don’t just show that a threat exists. They give each threat’s risk level and priority, so you know right away what to tackle first.


The summary report shows the main threats immediately. You can get the full report by email or review it with a MarqVision brand protection specialist.


## **Built on the same AI we use to protect brands**


[MarqRadar](https://www.marqvision.com/marqradar?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=MarqRadar_launch&utm_content=kr_blog) runs on the AI MarqVision uses to protect brands every day.


It’s the same technology that detected and acted on more than 60 million infringements in 2025.


With 99.8% AI verification accuracy, it monitors more than 1 billion domains and detects brand threats across 50+ online channels.


The free self-check is a quick first look at your main threats. A more thorough full scan typically finds 10 to 100 times more threats than the free check.


## **You can’t protect what you can’t see**


To protect a brand, you first need to know what threats exist.[MarqRadar](https://www.marqvision.com/marqradar?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=MarqRadar_launch&utm_content=kr_blog) lets anyone take that first step in 90 seconds.


See where, and how much, your brand is exposed right now.
